title: Can't open the box? Check around it. 🔍
text:
Can't open the box? Check around it. 🔍

Most enterprise LLMs are closed black boxes. You can't inspect the hidden weights or provider-level system prompts. But you don't have to—you can test what the agent knows by checking around the box.

Here is a 12-step framework across 4 tiers:

1. 🌍 The Real World (The Truth Itself):
   • Real-world probe: Compare agent beliefs with real databases.
   • Seeded world: Test with a controlled sandbox of known facts.
   • Human audit: Score random samples for silent drift.

2. 📁 The Stores (Notes, Logs & Docs):
   • Stale or clash: Scan for contradictions and expired records.
   • Find it again: Verify search retrieval hits the right record.
   • Plant bad facts: Test if your memory safety gate rejects fake data.

3. 🎛️ The Harness (What Goes In):
   • Prompt peek: Audit what actually reaches the context window.
   • With / without: Test if the model actually uses the provided context.
   • Swap a fact: Change one variable—does the output adjust accordingly?

4. 💬 The Answers (What Comes Out):
   • Quiz it: Test variations to expose overconfident hallucinations.
   • Show sources: Enforce and verify real citations.
   • Ask a stranger: Cross-evaluate with an independent model or tool.

💡 Pro tip: Start with the cheap, deterministic checks in Rows 2 & 3 before running expensive audits.
